result:
**Ensure every child receives a high-quality education, regardless of where they are born.**

Education is one of the highest-leverage changes because it compounds. It reduces poverty, improves health and nutrition outcomes, lowers conflict and extremism over generations, accelerates scientific and technological progress, and gives people the tools to solve other problems (climate, disease, governance) themselves. Literate, numerate, critically thinking populations make better decisions, innovate more, and are harder to exploit or radicalize.

Other candidates—ending extreme poverty/hunger, clean abundant energy, or eradicating major diseases—are also enormously valuable, but they are easier to sustain and scale once people have the knowledge and agency that education provides. A well-educated world is more likely to invent the solutions and build the institutions needed for the rest.

What would you change?
